findings.summary: The repo regex still accepts a segment starting with '-' (e.g. '-x/y'). Not exploitable: execFileSync uses no shell and the value is its own argument right after '--repo'. Optional tightening to require an alphanumeric first character. Same pattern at check-pr-status.ts:336.
